# Copilot instructions

These repository-wide instructions apply to GitHub Copilot and any other coding agent working in this project.

- Follow the project-wide instructions in the repo root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
- Prefer the simplest solution that satisfies the requirement.
- Reuse existing helpers and patterns before introducing new ones.
- Fix root causes instead of just patching symptoms.
- For anything involving Next.js in this repo, read the relevant guidance in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before writing code.
